tagline: 美能达胶片单反相机，1998 年发布
description: 美能达于1998年推出的胶片单反相机。快门速度electronically controlled focal plane shutter with speeds 30 sec. to 1/4000 sec.。使用35mm。感光度25 to 5000 ASA DX-coded (6 to 6400 manually)。TTL phase-detecting autofocus based on 2 vertical AF-sensors and a central cross-sensor, switchable to manual focusing or single sensor usage。

specs.曝光测光: 14 field TTL measuring with Si photo diode, switchable to spot metering via central field, manual correction +-3EV
specs.对焦: TTL phase-detecting autofocus based on 2 vertical AF-sensors and a central cross-sensor, switchable to manual focusing or single sensor usage
specs.快门: electronically controlled focal plane shutter with speeds 30 sec. to 1/4000 sec.
specs.取景器: pentamirror showing 90% of image, plus additional info in LCD sector, micro prism focusing aid for manual fosusing
specs.闪光灯: guide number 12, controlled by second Si photo diode, serves in dim light as autofocus support light
specs.英文简介: The Minolta Dynax 505si or Maxxum HTsi Plus is a simplified version of the Dynax 505si Super / Maxxum XTsi / α Sweet.
